lineups.title: A Lobby to A Site

lineups.span_provenance: AIM widened 14.91-15.0 -> 14.70-15.0 by operator frame-study (frames.sh y_m01a.png 12.5-15.1 and y_m01b.png 14.667-15.083, frame-exact). The punch-in crop, with the crosshair circled on the tan wall-top box, runs 13.24-14.875. Live and unzoomed with the blade raised is 14.917-14.958, the swing is at 15.0 and the release at 15.042. The AIM now opens on the punch-in's last ~5 frames.

lineups.span_provenance: LANDING measured (frames.sh y_m07l.png 153.3-154.7). The gate failed this row, but only because the shot changes to the thrower's post-cut Operator POV. The event itself is on screen: the burst sphere with radial rays appears at the pillar edge at 154.2, peaks at 154.29, shrinks to an orb by 154.37 and fades by ~154.46. excluded_no_event_in_source.title: B Lobby to B Site (Flash)
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the deploy is never on camera. The flash goes over the wall toward B Site, out of the throwing view, and every frame from release through 191.66 has no bloom, no whiteout and no wash. The only detonation evidence is the minimap icon turning red at 188.72, and the gate's LANDING frames are a different close-up with no deploy.

excluded_no_event_in_source.title: B Site to B Main (Flash)
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the deploy is never on camera. A per-frame luminance scan from 413.8 to 419.0 shows no bloom. The flash goes over the wall into B Main, and the landing section is an editor composite: dark shots from inside level geometry with a drawn blue trajectory arc and a ring at its end. That is not in-game deploy footage.
